hypothesis: Complete source-bound parent/child connection and current-streak chronology adds promotion discrimination beyond the original29 fields.
baseline: Original saved BASE; no baseline refitting; preserve all original inputs, labels, scores and failures.
features_fixed: Eligible explicit or grouped child/anchor connection with source-bound higher anchor when the current child streak starts: 1/0/unknown.
Source-bound child starts before the scoped anchor break and continues to signal close: 1/0/unknown.
Source-bound previous child first-board observation and current streak restarts on the scoped anchor break: 1/0/unknown.
feature_semantics: These are observed discussion/timing inputs, never confirmed supplement-dragon role labels or funds-causality labels. NAME_MATCH_ONLY is ineligible. Multiple anchor cycles without source-bound scope remain unknown. Unknown does not mean false.
missingness: Three added missing indicators; training-window medians only; preserve the original preprocessing for all original29 fields.
multiple_anchors: Apply the same fixed eligibility policy to every recorded alternative anchor; any eligible observed match yields1, known complete nonmatch0, unresolved source/chronology unknown. No anchor selected from next-day outcomes.
historical_inputs_required: The entire original dated candidate pool, including all failed/uncovered/unknown candidates; no winner-only relation bank.

A fixed bounded set of existing archived discussions, exact source spans, author/comment distinction, source versions, publication/capture/review clocks and all alternatives before inspecting target outcomes for extraction.
All market observations no later than each signal close; exact signal and next official session; a prior break is an explicit event, never inferred from missing boards.
Original mature promotion labels, unchanged members,252-session training windows,daily weights,C=0.25 and strict score>0.5. No role truths constructed from promotion or source opinions.
Freeze the full data manifest and eligibility/missingness audit before any fit. Current15 relation cards alone are insufficient historical input.
knowledge_time_policy: Real forward inputs must actually exist before judgement freeze. Late-retrieved historical source is separately qualified as retrospective current-knowledge diagnosis if publication/version and no-target-data restrictions hold; it is never an original-time qualification or fresh blind result.
role_training_boundary: The existing SUPPLEMENT supervised role and C2 OOF gates remain unmet. This does not ban historical promotion research using newly qualified directly observed inputs and original promotion labels.

evaluation.special_gate: September actual non-one-price Recall must not fall; original full denominators and source unknowns retained.
evaluation.uncertainty: Use the existing fixed common date-block paired interval and multiple-comparison policy; no ordinary independent-row confidence claims.
evaluation.unknown_metrics: Undefined metrics or insufficient complete source qualification cannot pass.
evaluation.probability: No Brier claim without a calibrated probability.
evaluation.stop: After completion,failure or30-minute budget stop; preserve predictions before downstream checks; no threshold/weight/feature tuning or rerun from results.

forward_gate: Winning retrospective diagnostics still require the original fixed source and120-day forward acceptance before deployment. Record all candidates and abstentions before model display; keep recognition, promotion and execution outcomes distinct.
